title: feat: add E2B to Economics balances
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Registers E2B as an Infrastructure capacity vendor
- Adds the Myceli project, billing access, and monthly balance tracking
- Documents dashboard collection plus official API and CLI limits
- Adds registry lifecycle coverage for the E2B account

Tests: provider registry (19 passed), TypeScript, staging registry audit

gist.headline: A new ledger joins the garden
gist.blurb: E2B now has a tidy spot in the Economics hive. Its capacity, billing access, and monthly balance can be watched without making someone open another tab.
gist.summary: Registered E2B as an Infrastructure capacity vendor in the Economics provider registry, including the Myceli project, billing access, monthly balance tracking, documented dashboard/API/CLI limits, and lifecycle test coverage.
gist.impact: Operators can now track E2B's Myceli account balance and collection paths alongside the other infrastructure providers, with registry checks covering its account lifecycle.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden bookkeeper adding an E2B-labeled jar of pollen to a cozy provider ledger, while a small code-plant represents the Myceli project and a retro terminal shows a monthly balance chart. The scene should communicate organized infrastructure accounting rather than user billing; include flowers and vines as the registry growing by one provider.
